transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As you're likely aware, Cell 6 has gone down due to a controller fault during its scheduled setup, so it's unavailable for the current production campaign. I'm looking to get Cell 3 stood up as a temporary alternate route — it's idle and capable of welding the same bracket family with its manual fixture. We have a customer order for 300 brackets from this campaign, so we need to keep things moving. Per procedure, before I approve the temporary route change and release the campaign, I need to conduct a pre-release review with quality, maintenance, materials, and safety. I'd like to get all of those stakeholders together as soon as possible to walk through this. Can we get that review scheduled?
